key_insight: Cermet coating c2 delivered the best performance among three compositions, combining 1210 HV microhardness with a 10.1 mg/h abrasive wear rate.
engineering_relevance: HVOF-sprayed cermet coatings could improve the wear resistance and corrosion protection of AISI 316L marine pump impellers.
method: Applied coatings combining one ceramic phase with three metallic binders to AISI 316L using HVOF spraying.
Characterized coating microstructure and phases using SEM and XRD.
Evaluated slurry erosion, microhardness, roughness, adhesion strength, and electrochemical corrosion.
evidence_signal: Across three compositions, c2 showed the highest hardness, lowest wear rate, superior adhesion and corrosion resistance, and a dense microstructure with minimal porosity.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify coating compositions, test conditions, or long-term impeller service validation, limiting reproducibility and field-performance assessment.
paper_title: Systematic Evaluation of Abrasive Wear Resistance in Smart Cermet Marine Coatings for High-Speed Pump Impellers
